name: Technology Department
description: The internal department responsible for technology systems, architecture, and digital infrastructure at FirstUK Bank. Owns and maintains all core banking systems and customer-facing digital channels.

name: Chief Technology Officer
description: Executive leadership role responsible for overseeing the Technology Department and all technology systems and architecture at FirstUK Bank. Listed as the owner of this systems documentation.

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The primary banking organization operating an integrated technology architecture supporting retail banking operations across multiple branches and digital channels.
context: FirstUK Bank operates an integrated technology architecture supporting retail banking operations across 12 branches and digital channels

name: System Availability SLA
description: The contractual service level agreement target for system availability set at 99.8%, representing the minimum uptime commitment for FirstUK Bank's core banking infrastructure.

name: System Uptime 2025
description: The actual system uptime performance achieved in 2025, measured at 99.85%, exceeding the contractual SLA target of 99.8%.

name: Core Banking System
description: One of five major systems within FirstUK Bank's integrated technology architecture, supporting retail banking operations and microservices-based infrastructure.
context: The architecture emphasizes microservices, API-first design, and cloud-ready infrastructure

name: API Gateway
description: The API-first infrastructure component providing 45+ endpoints to support FirstUK Bank's microservices architecture and digital channel integration.
context: The architecture emphasizes microservices, API-first design, and cloud-ready infrastructure

name: Data Warehouse
description: A real-time data processing system integrated into FirstUK Bank's technology architecture to support analytics and operational reporting.

name: Regulatory Compliance Requirement
description: A foundational governance constraint requiring FirstUK Bank's technology architecture to maintain regulatory compliance across all retail banking operations.
context: The architecture emphasizes microservices, API-first design, and cloud-ready infrastructure while maintaining regulatory compliance and security

name: Security Control Framework
description: A mandatory operational constraint requiring FirstUK Bank to maintain security standards across its integrated technology architecture.
context: The architecture emphasizes microservices, API-first design, and cloud-ready infrastructure while maintaining regulatory compliance and security

name: Microservices Architecture
description: Event-driven, microservices-based architecture serving as the foundational technology platform for FirstUK Bank's systems. Designed to support API-first integration and real-time data processing capabilities.

name: Cloud Infrastructure
description: Hybrid cloud infrastructure platform designed to support FirstUK Bank's technology operations with cloud-ready capabilities and flexibility.

name: Real-time Data Processing and Analytics System
description: Real-time data processing and analytics platform enabling immediate insights and monitoring across FirstUK Bank's operations.

name: API Gateway
description: API-first integration model serving as the primary mechanism for system integration and external connectivity at FirstUK Bank.

name: Zero-Trust Security System
description: Security-first design framework implementing zero-trust principles across FirstUK Bank's technology infrastructure.

name: Open Banking Compliance Platform
description: System ensuring FirstUK Bank's compliance with Open Banking regulations, PSD2 requirements, and Open Banking Standard specifications.
context: Open Banking compliance (PSD2, Open Banking Standard)

name: FCA COBS Compliance Obligation
description: FirstUK Bank must comply with FCA Conduct of Business (COBS) rules governing customer conduct and business practices.

name: PRA Rulebook Capital and Liquidity Requirement
description: FirstUK Bank must maintain capital and liquidity standards as mandated by the PRA Rulebook.

name: GDPR Data Protection Compliance
description: FirstUK Bank must comply with GDPR requirements for data protection and customer data handling.

name: Open Banking Regulatory Compliance
description: FirstUK Bank must comply with Open Banking regulations governing third-party access and data sharing.

name: Account Management System
description: Central repository for customer accounts, balances, and transactions. Built on Java microservices with PostgreSQL backend, deployed on AWS cloud infrastructure. Manages account creation, lifecycle, balance tracking, transaction recording, interest calculation, and account status monitoring.
context: Central repository for customer accounts, balances, and transactions
Account creation and lifecycle, Balance management, Transaction recording, Interest calculation, Account status tracking

name: Internet Banking Platform
description: Customer-facing digital channel integrated with the Account Management System for account access and transaction management.

name: Mobile Banking App
description: Mobile application channel integrated with the Account Management System for customer account access and transaction management.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: System integrated with Account Management System to monitor and detect fraudulent transactions and account activities.

name: Data Warehouse
description: Analytics and reporting system integrated with Account Management System for data aggregation and business intelligence.

name: PostgreSQL Database
description: Primary relational database for Account Management System storing customer, account, account holder, transaction, and account status data. Version 13 or higher with daily encrypted backup to S3.
context: Backup: Daily encrypted backup to S3

name: S3 Backup Storage
description: Cloud storage service for encrypted daily backups of the PostgreSQL database with 15-minute Recovery Point Objective.
context: Backup: Daily encrypted backup to S3

name: Account
description: Core banking entity representing a customer account with associated balance, transaction history, and lifecycle state. Managed centrally in the Account Management System data model.

name: Account Holder
description: Legal party with rights and obligations over an account, including primary, secondary, and joint account holders. Tracked in Account Management System data model.

name: Customer
description: Natural person who holds or is associated with banking accounts and transactions. Stored as core entity in Account Management System data model.

name: Transaction
description: Financial event recorded on a customer account including deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and payments. Centrally managed and tracked in Account Management System.

name: Account Status
description: State attribute of an account tracked in the Account Management System data model, including lifecycle and operational status.

name: Account Management System Availability Target
description: Service level agreement for Account Management System uptime and availability.

name: Recovery Point Objective
description: Maximum acceptable data loss window for Account Management System backups, set at 15 minutes for daily encrypted backups to S3.

name: Account Management System Data Volume
description: Current data capacity of Account Management System PostgreSQL database storing approximately 1.6 million transaction records across 800 accounts.

name: Internet Banking Platform
description: Web-based customer portal enabling self-service account access, transaction management, and payment operations. Built on React.js frontend and Node.js backend, deployed on AWS cloud infrastructure with 99.8% availability SLA. Provides secure login via username/password and OTP, account dashboards, transaction history, standing orders, direct debits, beneficiary management, money transfers, and e-statements.
context: Web-based customer portal for account access and self-service

name: Account Management System
description: Core banking system providing account data integration to the Internet Banking Platform. Serves as the authoritative source for customer account information accessed through IBP.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: System responsible for transaction validation and fraud detection, integrated with the Internet Banking Platform to monitor and validate customer transactions in real-time.

name: Payment Processing System
description: System that executes money transfer and payment operations initiated through the Internet Banking Platform, handling the settlement and processing of customer-initiated transfers.

name: Internet Banking Platform Availability Target
description: Service level agreement specifying the required uptime for the Internet Banking Platform.

name: Internet Banking Platform Response Time Target
description: Performance target for the 95th percentile response time of the Internet Banking Platform under normal operating conditions.

name: Internet Banking Platform Daily Active Users
description: Operational metric tracking the typical daily active user count on the Internet Banking Platform.

name: Session Idle Timeout Control
description: Security control requiring automatic session termination after 15 minutes of user inactivity on the Internet Banking Platform to protect against unauthorized access.

name: Two-Factor Authentication Requirement
description: Security control mandating two-factor authentication via OTP delivered through email or SMS for all Internet Banking Platform logins.

name: TLS 1.3 Encryption Standard
description: Encryption standard requirement for all data in transit on the Internet Banking Platform, enforcing TLS 1.3 protocol.

name: XSS and CSRF Protection Requirement
description: Security control requiring implementation of Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection mechanisms on the Internet Banking Platform.

name: SQL Injection Prevention Requirement
description: Security control requiring implementation of SQL injection prevention mechanisms across the Internet Banking Platform backend systems.

name: Standing Order
description: A recurring payment instruction that customers can set up, manage, and cancel through the Internet Banking Platform as part of self-service payment capabilities.

name: Direct Debit
description: A payment mandate that customers can establish and manage through the Internet Banking Platform for recurring payments to third parties.

name: Transaction
description: Financial events on customer accounts including deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and payments that are displayed in transaction history and monitored for fraud through the Internet Banking Platform.

name: Money Transfer
description: A customer-initiated payment operation executed through the Internet Banking Platform and processed by the Payment Processing System.

name: Beneficiary
description: A third-party recipient that customers can register and manage through the Internet Banking Platform for payment and transfer operations.

name: Mobile Banking App
description: Native mobile application for iOS and Android enabling customers to access banking services including account viewing, transactions, card management, and money transfers. Built on React Native with Node.js backend, deployed on AWS cloud infrastructure with CloudFront CDN.
context: Native mobile application for iOS and Android

name: Account Management System
description: Core banking system integrated with the Mobile Banking App to provide account viewing and management capabilities.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: System integrated with the Mobile Banking App to detect and prevent fraudulent transactions and account activities.

name: Push Notification Service
description: Service that delivers transaction alerts, security alerts, marketing messages, and service notifications to mobile app users.

name: Mobile Banking App Availability Target
description: Service level agreement for the Mobile Banking App specifying minimum uptime commitment.

name: Mobile Banking App Daily Active Users
description: Key performance indicator tracking the number of daily active users of the Mobile Banking App.

name: Biometric Authentication
description: Security feature enabling customers to authenticate to the Mobile Banking App using facial recognition, fingerprint, or touch ID, with PIN fallback.

name: Virtual Card Number
description: Feature allowing customers to generate temporary or disposable card numbers for online shopping transactions via the Mobile Banking App.

name: Card Lock/Unlock
description: Capability within the Mobile Banking App allowing customers to temporarily lock or unlock their payment cards for security purposes.

name: Push Notification
description: Real-time alert mechanism delivering transaction alerts, security alerts, marketing messages, and service notifications to Mobile Banking App users.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: Real-time fraud detection and prevention system deployed across cloud (AWS) and on-premises infrastructure. Combines rule-based detection, ML anomaly models, and transaction risk scoring to identify and block fraudulent transactions with <100ms latency. Integrates with account management, internet banking, mobile banking, and payment processing systems.
context: Purpose: Real-time detection and prevention of fraudulent transactions
Technology: Python, Apache Kafka, TensorFlow (ML models)

name: Account Management System
description: Core banking system that provides transaction data to the Fraud Detection Engine for real-time risk assessment and monitoring.

name: Internet Banking Platform
description: Customer-facing internet banking channel integrated with the Fraud Detection Engine for real-time transaction blocking and fraud prevention.

name: Mobile Banking App
description: Mobile banking application integrated with the Fraud Detection Engine to support real-time fraud detection and transaction monitoring.

name: Payment Processing System
description: Payment processing system that interfaces with the Fraud Detection Engine to enable real-time transaction risk assessment and blocking.

name: Financial Crime System
description: System responsible for SAR filing and suspicious activity reporting, integrated with the Fraud Detection Engine for escalation of high-risk fraud alerts.

name: Financial Crime Team
description: Department responsible for investigating and escalating high-risk fraud alerts from the Fraud Detection Engine and managing suspicious activity reporting.
context: High Risk: Block transaction, notify customer, escalate to Financial Crime team

name: Transaction
description: A financial event subject to real-time fraud detection and risk scoring by the Fraud Detection Engine. Transactions are assessed for risk using rule-based detection, ML anomaly models, and transaction risk scoring.
context: Real-time detection and prevention of fraudulent transactions

name: Fraud Alert
description: A fraud detection alert generated by the Fraud Detection Engine when suspicious activity is flagged. Alerts are escalated based on risk level: low-risk alerts are auto-approved, medium-risk require OTP verification, and high-risk alerts trigger transaction blocking and customer notification.
context: Alert Escalation: Low Risk: Auto-approve, Medium Risk: Require OTP verification, High Risk: Block transaction, notify customer, escalate to Financial Crime team

name: Card Fraud Prevention
description: Fraud detection capability within the Fraud Detection Engine that identifies and prevents fraudulent card transactions, including card-not-present (CNP) high-value transactions.

name: Account Takeover Detection
description: Fraud detection capability within the Fraud Detection Engine that identifies unauthorized account access and fraudulent activity on compromised customer accounts.

name: SAR Filing
description: Suspicious Activity Report filing process integrated with the Fraud Detection Engine. High-risk fraud alerts are escalated to the Financial Crime System for SAR preparation and filing with relevant authorities.

name: Transaction Risk Scoring Latency
description: Performance target for the Fraud Detection Engine to assess transaction risk and return a decision within 100 milliseconds.

name: Fraud Detection Rate
description: Performance metric indicating the Fraud Detection Engine's ability to identify fraudulent transactions, with a target of 97% or higher.

name: False Positive Rate
description: Performance metric measuring the proportion of legitimate transactions incorrectly flagged as fraudulent by the Fraud Detection Engine, maintained below 2%.

name: Monthly Fraud Prevention Value
description: Monthly financial impact of fraud prevention by the Fraud Detection Engine, ranging from approximately £45,000 to £80,000.

name: Large Transaction Amount Fraud Rule
description: Fraud detection rule that flags transactions exceeding £5,000 for additional risk assessment and potential blocking.

name: Geographic Anomaly Fraud Rule
description: Fraud detection rule that flags transactions occurring in different countries within a 2-hour window as potentially fraudulent.
context: Geographic anomaly (transaction in different country within 2 hours)

name: Velocity Check Fraud Rule
description: Fraud detection rule that flags accounts with more than 5 transactions within a 1-hour period as potentially fraudulent.

name: Unusual Beneficiary Fraud Rule
description: Fraud detection rule that flags large transfers to new beneficiaries as potentially fraudulent.

name: Card-Not-Present High-Value Transaction Fraud Rule
description: Fraud detection rule that flags high-value card-not-present (CNP) transactions for additional risk assessment.

name: Low-Risk Fraud Alert Auto-Approval
description: Operational rule that permits automatic approval of transactions flagged as low-risk by the Fraud Detection Engine without additional customer verification.

name: Medium-Risk Fraud Alert OTP Verification
description: Operational rule requiring one-time password (OTP) verification for transactions flagged as medium-risk by the Fraud Detection Engine.

name: High-Risk Fraud Alert Escalation
description: Operational rule requiring high-risk transactions to be blocked, the customer notified, and the alert escalated to the Financial Crime team for investigation.
context: High Risk: Block transaction, notify customer, escalate to Financial Crime team

name: Payment Processing System
description: Core payment processing platform handling customer payments and inter-bank settlements in real-time and batch modes. Processes Faster Payments Service, BACS, CHAPS, and internal transfers with 24/7 availability and 99.95% success rate.
context: Process customer payments and inter-bank settlements

name: Account Management System
description: System responsible for account validation and management functions integrated with the Payment Processing System to validate accounts during payment processing.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: Fraud detection system integrated with Payment Processing System to perform fraud checks on payment transactions before settlement.

name: Treasury System
description: System responsible for reconciliation and reporting functions integrated with Payment Processing System for settlement reconciliation.

name: Bank of England Settlement Systems
description: External settlement infrastructure operated by the Bank of England for inter-bank payment settlement and clearing.

name: Standing Order
description: Recurring payment instruction processed by the Payment Processing System as a key function of the payment platform.

name: Direct Debit
description: Direct debit payment instruction processed by the Payment Processing System as a core payment method.

name: Transfer
description: Payment transfer initiated and validated through the Payment Processing System, including internal transfers between accounts at the same bank.

name: FPS Processing Time
description: Service level target for Faster Payments Service processing completion.

name: BACS Processing Time
description: Service level target for BACS batch payment processing completion.

name: Payment Processing Success Rate
description: Overall success rate target for payment transactions processed through the Payment Processing System.

name: Failed Transactions Daily Threshold
description: Maximum acceptable number of failed payment transactions per day in the Payment Processing System.

name: BACS Submission Deadline
description: Operational constraint specifying the daily submission deadline for BACS batch payments to the clearing system.

name: Faster Payments Service Limit
description: Maximum transaction value limit for Faster Payments Service payments processed through the Payment Processing System.
context: Faster Payments Service (FPS) — Real-time, up to £1M

name: CHAPS Real-Time Processing Constraint
description: Operational rule restricting CHAPS real-time processing to business hours only.

name: Data Warehouse
description: Centralized analytics and business intelligence platform serving FirstUK Bank's data analysis needs. Built on AWS Redshift and Apache Spark with a star schema data model supporting real-time hot data and nightly batch processing of historical data. Hosts multiple specialized data marts covering customers, accounts, transactions, products, and compliance domains.
context: Update Frequency: Real-time (for hot data), nightly batch (historical)

name: Customer Mart
description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing customer-centric analytics and attributes. Supports 500 customers with 50 attributes each for customer analytics and segmentation.

name: Account Mart
description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing account-level analytics and dimensional data. Supports 800 accounts with associated attributes for account performance analysis.

name: Transaction Mart
description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing transaction-level analytics and monitoring data. Processes 2,000+ monthly transactions for transaction analysis and fraud detection.

name: Product Mart
description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing product performance metrics and analytics. Tracks 5 products with associated performance metrics for product analytics and reporting.

name: Compliance Mart
description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing compliance, regulatory, and risk data. Aggregates KYC verification, AML screening, and customer complaints data for compliance monitoring and reporting.
context: Compliance Mart: KYC, AML, complaints data

name: Executive Dashboard
description: Daily KPI reporting dashboard providing executive-level visibility into bank performance metrics and key indicators.

name: Product Performance Dashboard
description: Analytics dashboard tracking and reporting on the performance metrics of FirstUK Bank's product portfolio.

name: Fraud Detection Dashboard
description: Real-time monitoring and alerting dashboard for fraud detection and investigation, supporting fraud alert generation and response.

name: Compliance & Risk Dashboard
description: Compliance and risk monitoring dashboard providing visibility into regulatory obligations, AML screening, KYC verification status, and risk metrics.

name: Customer Analytics Dashboard
description: Customer-focused analytics dashboard providing insights into customer behavior, segmentation, and engagement metrics.

name: Customer Mart Capacity
description: Capacity metric for the Customer Mart data mart, tracking the volume of customer records and attributes maintained.

name: Account Mart Capacity
description: Capacity metric for the Account Mart data mart, tracking the volume of account records maintained.

name: Transaction Mart Processing Rate
description: Processing rate metric for the Transaction Mart, tracking monthly transaction volume processed through the data warehouse.

name: Product Mart Coverage
description: Coverage metric for the Product Mart, tracking the number of products with performance metrics maintained in the data warehouse.

name: Data Retention Policy
description: Tiered data retention policy governing how long data is maintained in the Data Warehouse across hot, warm, and cold storage tiers. Hot data retained for 3 months in real-time, warm data for 1-3 years in nightly batch, and cold data archived to S3 after 3+ years.

name: Document Management System
description: A centralized system for storing and managing banking documents including policies, procedures, templates, reports, and audit documents. Built on Elasticsearch and S3 technology stack to support organizational document governance and compliance record-keeping.
context: Purpose: Store and manage documents (policies, procedures, templates)

name: Policy
description: Formal governance documents stored within the Document Management System that define organizational standards, controls, and compliance requirements across FirstUK Bank departments.
context: Store and manage documents (policies, procedures, templates)

name: Procedure
description: Documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) maintained in the Document Management System that specify step-by-step operational workflows and execution standards across the bank.
context: Store and manage documents (policies, procedures, templates)

name: Template
description: Standardized document templates stored in the DMS for customer communications and internal use, including letters, emails, and SMS messages to ensure consistency and compliance.
context: Store and manage documents (policies, procedures, templates)

name: Report
description: Formal reports generated and archived within the Document Management System for operational, compliance, and audit purposes.
context: Store and manage documents (policies, procedures, templates)

name: Audit Document
description: Documentation maintained in the DMS to support internal and external audit activities, providing evidence of control execution and compliance verification.
context: Store and manage documents (policies, procedures, templates)

name: Customer Relationship Management System
description: Cloud-based Salesforce CRM platform operated by FirstUK Bank for managing customer interactions, relationship tracking, and complaint handling. Integrates with the Account Management System, email system, and phone system to maintain comprehensive customer contact information and interaction history.
context: Purpose: Customer interaction and relationship tracking

name: Account Management System
description: Core banking system integrated with the CRM platform to manage customer accounts and account-related data within FirstUK Bank's infrastructure.

name: Email System
description: Email communication system integrated with the CRM to support customer interaction tracking and email-based correspondence logging.

name: Phone System
description: Telephony system integrated with the CRM to track and record customer phone interactions and call history.

name: Customer Contact Information
description: Core customer data entity maintained within the CRM system, encompassing contact details and identification information used for customer relationship management and communication.

name: Interaction History
description: Record of all customer interactions tracked within the CRM, including calls, emails, and other communication events that form the basis of relationship tracking.

name: Complaint
description: Customer complaints tracked and managed within the CRM system as part of FirstUK Bank's complaint handling and customer service processes.

name: Marketing Campaign
description: Marketing initiatives tracked within the CRM system to monitor campaign performance, customer engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

name: Customer Feedback
description: Customer opinions, suggestions, and feedback collected and managed within the CRM to inform service improvements and customer experience enhancements.

name: Reporting & Regulatory System
description: On-premises system responsible for generating regulatory reports required by the FCA and PRA. Built on Python and XBRL toolkit, it produces CASS, COREP, FINREP, and AML reports for regulatory compliance.
context: Purpose: Generate regulatory reports for FCA/PRA

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: UK financial regulator that receives regulatory reports from FirstUK Bank, including CASS, COREP, FINREP, and AML reports.

name: Prudential Regulation Authority
description: UK prudential regulator that receives regulatory reports from FirstUK Bank for capital and exposure monitoring.

name: CASS Report
description: Regulatory report generated under the Client Assets sourcebook requirements, produced by the Reporting & Regulatory System for FCA submission.

name: COREP Report
description: Regulatory report detailing capital requirements and exposure metrics, generated by the Reporting & Regulatory System for FCA/PRA submission.

name: FINREP Report
description: Financial regulatory report produced by the Reporting & Regulatory System for submission to FCA/PRA.

name: AML Report
description: Anti-Money Laundering report documenting suspicious activity, generated by the Reporting & Regulatory System for regulatory submission.

name: Internet Banking Portal
description: Customer-facing digital channel providing access to banking services through a web portal interface. Connects to the API Gateway for transaction processing and account management.

name: Mobile Application
description: Mobile banking application providing customer access to accounts and transactions. Integrated with the API Gateway for real-time processing.

name: Branch Systems
description: On-premise banking systems deployed at branch locations for customer-facing transactions and account management. Connected to the API Gateway infrastructure.

name: API Gateway
description: Central API gateway (Kong) serving as the integration hub between customer-facing channels (IBP, Mobile, Branch) and backend processing systems. Routes requests to AMS, Fraud Detection Engine, and Payment Processing System.

name: Account Management System
description: Core system responsible for account lifecycle management, customer data, and account state. Accessible through the API Gateway from all customer channels.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: Real-time fraud detection system monitoring transactions and account activity. Integrated with the API Gateway to flag suspicious transactions and prevent fraudulent activity.

name: Payment Processing System
description: System handling payment execution and settlement. Processes transactions through payment scheme operators and connects to Bank of England settlement systems.

name: Data Warehouse
description: Central repository for historical transaction data, customer analytics, and reporting. Supports business intelligence and regulatory reporting requirements.

name: Bank of England
description: Central bank providing settlement infrastructure and payment system oversight. Operates settlement systems used by FirstUK Bank for payment clearing and settlement.

name: Payment Scheme Operators
description: External payment scheme operators managing Faster Payments Service (FPS), Bankers' Automated Clearing Services (BACS), and Clearing House Automated Payment System (CHAPS). FirstUK Bank participates in these schemes for payment processing.

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: UK financial regulator responsible for conduct regulation and consumer protection. Exercises regulatory authority over FirstUK Bank's operations.

name: Prudential Regulation Authority
description: UK prudential regulator responsible for safety and soundness of banks. Exercises regulatory authority over FirstUK Bank's capital and risk management.

name: Account API
description: RESTful API gateway providing account management operations including creation, retrieval, balance inquiry, and transaction listing. Supports both JWT and API Key authentication mechanisms for different operational contexts.
context: | `/accounts` | POST | Create account | API Key + JWT |

name: Transaction Recording System
description: Internal system endpoint for recording financial transactions against customer accounts. Restricted to API Key authentication for internal-only access.

name: Standing Order Management System
description: API endpoint for managing standing order instructions on customer accounts, supporting both retrieval and creation of standing order arrangements.

name: Direct Debit Management System
description: API endpoint for managing direct debit mandates on customer accounts, supporting both retrieval and creation of direct debit arrangements.

name: Account
description: Core banking entity representing a customer account that can be created, queried for balance and transaction history, and linked to standing orders and direct debit mandates.
context: | `/accounts` | POST | Create account | API Key + JWT |

name: Transaction
description: Financial event recorded against a customer account, retrievable via API and recordable through internal systems for audit and reporting purposes.

name: Standing Order
description: Recurring payment instruction set up on a customer account, manageable through dedicated API endpoints for creation and retrieval.

name: Direct Debit
description: Direct debit mandate established on a customer account, manageable through dedicated API endpoints for creation and retrieval.

name: Account Creation Authentication Requirement
description: Account creation endpoint requires dual authentication using both API Key and JWT token, enforcing a two-factor authentication control for account provisioning.
context: | `/accounts` | POST | Create account | API Key + JWT |

name: Internal Transaction Recording Access Control
description: Transaction recording endpoint is restricted to internal systems only, authenticated via API Key rather than JWT, enforcing separation between customer-facing and internal operations.

name: Customer-Facing API Authentication Standard
description: All customer-facing API endpoints for account retrieval, balance inquiry, transaction listing, and payment instruction management require JWT authentication.

name: Payment APIs
description: A collection of RESTful API endpoints that facilitate payment processing through multiple channels including FPS (Faster Payment Service) and BACS (Bankers' Automated Clearing Services). All endpoints require JWT authentication and support POST method operations for payment initiation and validation.

name: FPS Transfer Endpoint
description: API endpoint that processes Faster Payment Service (FPS) transfers. Accepts POST requests and requires JWT authentication for secure access.

name: BACS Transfer Endpoint
description: API endpoint that processes BACS (Bankers' Automated Clearing Services) transfers. Accepts POST requests and requires JWT authentication for secure access.

name: Payment Validation Endpoint
description: API endpoint that validates payment requests before processing. Accepts POST requests and requires JWT authentication to ensure only authorized callers can perform validation checks.

name: JWT Authentication Requirement for Payment APIs
description: All payment API endpoints require JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication. This is a security control that ensures only authorized and authenticated clients can invoke payment operations across FPS, BACS, and validation services.

name: Customer APIs
description: A set of RESTful API endpoints for customer management, KYC verification, and AML screening operations. Supports customer creation, retrieval, and compliance screening with JWT and API Key authentication mechanisms.
context: `/customers` | POST | Create customer | API Key + JWT

name: KYC Verification
description: A compliance verification process accessible via the Customer APIs endpoint `/customers/{id}/kyc` using internal API Key authentication. Supports both retrieval and submission of KYC verification data.

name: AML Screening
description: An AML screening operation executed via the Customer APIs endpoint `/customers/{id}/aml-screening` using internal API Key authentication. Performs compliance checks on customer records.

name: Customer
description: A core banking entity representing an individual or organization that can be created, retrieved, and subjected to compliance verification through the Customer APIs. Serves as the primary subject for KYC and AML screening operations.
context: | `/customers` | POST | Create customer | API Key + JWT

name: API Authentication Requirement
description: A security control mandating that customer creation requires both API Key and JWT authentication, while internal compliance operations (KYC and AML screening) require API Key authentication only.
context: | `/customers` | POST | Create customer | API Key + JWT

name: Card APIs
description: A set of RESTful API endpoints that enable card management operations including locking, unlocking, and replacement of payment cards. The APIs are secured via JWT authentication and provide programmatic access to card lifecycle management functions.

name: Card Lock
description: A card management operation that temporarily disables a payment card, preventing its use in transactions. Accessible via the POST /cards/{id}/lock endpoint with JWT authentication.

name: Card Unlock
description: A card management operation that re-enables a previously locked payment card, restoring its transaction capability. Accessible via the POST /cards/{id}/unlock endpoint with JWT authentication.

name: Card Replacement
description: A card management operation that initiates the issuance of a replacement payment card, typically used when a card is lost, damaged, or compromised. Accessible via the POST /cards/{id}/replace endpoint with JWT authentication.

name: Card API JWT Authentication Requirement
description: A security control requiring that all card management API endpoints (lock, unlock, replace) must be accessed only with valid JWT authentication tokens. This ensures that only authorized callers can perform sensitive card operations.

name: Fraud Scoring API
description: An internal API endpoint that scores transactions for fraud risk. Accessed via POST method and secured with internal API Key authentication. Part of the bank's fraud detection infrastructure.

name: Fraud Alerts API
description: An internal API endpoint that retrieves and lists fraud alerts. Accessed via GET method and secured with internal API Key authentication. Provides visibility into active fraud detection events.

name: Fraud APIs
description: A collection of internal API endpoints dedicated to fraud detection and alert management. Includes transaction scoring and alert listing capabilities, both secured with internal API Key authentication.

name: Reporting API Gateway
description: An internal API gateway that exposes three reporting endpoints for customer, transaction, and compliance data retrieval. Authentication is managed via API Key credentials restricted to internal use.

name: Customer Report Endpoint
description: A GET endpoint that retrieves customer report data, secured by internal API Key authentication.

name: Transaction Report Endpoint
description: A GET endpoint that retrieves transaction report data, secured by internal API Key authentication.

name: Compliance Report Endpoint
description: A GET endpoint that retrieves compliance report data, secured by internal API Key authentication.

name: API Key Authentication Requirement
description: All reporting API endpoints require API Key authentication restricted to internal use only. This control ensures that customer, transaction, and compliance reports are accessible only to authorized internal systems and personnel.

name: Apache Kafka
description: Event-driven asynchronous messaging platform used to publish and consume banking events across FirstUK Bank systems. Kafka handles critical event topics including account lifecycle, transactions, fraud detection, KYC completion, and standing order processing.
context: Key Topics: `account.created` — New account opened, `transaction.recorded` — Transaction completed, `account.closed` — Account closed, `fraud.alert` — Fraud detection alert, `kyc.completed` — KYC verification done, `standing-order.processed` — Standing order executed

name: Internet Banking Platform
description: Customer-facing digital channel through which customers initiate financial transactions such as transfers. The IBP is the entry point for transaction requests that flow through downstream validation and fraud detection systems.

name: Payment Processing System
description: Core system responsible for validating and processing payment transfers. PPS validates transfer requests and publishes transfer initiation events, then processes approved transfers and publishes completion events.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: System that evaluates transactions for fraud risk and publishes fraud scoring events. FDE checks fraud status as part of the transfer processing workflow and determines whether transactions are approved or blocked.

name: Account Management System
description: Core banking system responsible for maintaining account state and balances. AMS updates account balances following transaction completion and publishes balance update events.

name: Data Warehouse
description: Analytics and reporting system that consumes events from Kafka and makes transaction and account data available for reporting and analysis. Data is available in the warehouse approximately 5 minutes after transaction completion.
context: DW updates data → analytics available in 5 min

name: Account
description: A customer account that can be opened, closed, and have its balance updated through transactions. Accounts are tracked through their lifecycle via Kafka events including account.created and account.closed.

name: Transaction
description: A financial event representing the completion of a transfer or payment. Transactions are recorded, validated for fraud, and tracked through the event-driven architecture.

name: Fraud Alert
description: A fraud detection alert generated when the Fraud Detection Engine scores a transaction. Fraud alerts are published as events and influence transaction approval decisions.

name: KYC Verification
description: Know Your Customer verification process that is completed and tracked through the event-driven system. KYC completion events are published to Kafka for downstream consumption.

name: Standing Order
description: A recurring payment instruction that is processed and tracked through the event-driven architecture. Standing order execution events are published to Kafka.

name: Transfer Validation Rule
description: Operational rule requiring that all transfer requests initiated via the Internet Banking Platform must be validated by the Payment Processing System before proceeding to fraud detection.

name: Fraud Check Approval Gate
description: Control requiring that all transfers must pass fraud detection scoring by the Fraud Detection Engine before the Payment Processing System can process and complete the transfer.

name: API Gateway
description: Kong-based API Gateway that manages authentication, rate limiting, and monitoring for FirstUK Bank's synchronous integrations. Serves as the central control point for 45+ RESTful API endpoints.
context: API Gateway: Kong (manages authentication, rate limiting, monitoring)

name: RESTful API Endpoints
description: Collection of 45+ RESTful API endpoints that provide synchronous integration capabilities for FirstUK Bank's systems and third-party consumers.

name: JWT Authentication
description: Session-based JWT authentication method used for customer access to FirstUK Bank APIs.

name: API Key Authentication
description: API Key-based authentication method used for internal services accessing FirstUK Bank APIs.

name: OAuth 2.0 Authentication
description: OAuth 2.0 authentication method planned for future implementation to support third-party integrations with FirstUK Bank APIs.

name: FirstUK Production Database
description: PostgreSQL production database hosting core banking data including accounts, customers, transactions, and compliance records. Supports 800+ account records, 500+ customer records, and 2,000+ monthly transactions with continuous replication and daily encrypted backup to AWS S3.
context: Daily encrypted backup to AWS S3

name: Account Records Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing account records within the FirstUK production database. Contains 800 account records indexed by Account ID for efficient query performance.

name: Customer Records Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing customer records within the FirstUK production database. Contains 500 customer records indexed by Customer ID for efficient lookups.

name: Transaction Log Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing transaction records within the FirstUK production database. Maintains 2,000+ transaction records per month indexed by transaction date for historical analysis and reporting.

name: Account Holders Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing joint account holder records within the FirstUK production database, capturing relationships between multiple account holders and their accounts.

name: Standing Orders Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing standing order payment instructions within the FirstUK production database, capturing recurring transfer configurations.

name: Direct Debits Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing direct debit mandate records within the FirstUK production database, capturing recurring bill payment configurations.

name: Cards Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing debit card records within the FirstUK production database. Contains 800 card records linked to customer accounts.

name: Compliance KYC Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing Know Your Customer verification records within the FirstUK production database, capturing identity and address verification data.

name: Compliance AML Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing Anti-Money Laundering screening records within the FirstUK production database, capturing sanctions and PEP list check results.

name: Products Schema
description: PostgreSQL schema storing product definitions within the FirstUK production database. Contains 5 product definitions available to customers.

name: AWS S3 Backup Storage
description: Cloud storage service used for encrypted daily backups of the FirstUK production database, providing off-site disaster recovery capability.
context: Daily encrypted backup to AWS S3

name: Standby Database
description: PostgreSQL standby database receiving continuous replication from the primary FirstUK production database, supporting high availability and disaster recovery objectives.

name: Recovery Point Objective
description: Service level agreement defining the maximum acceptable data loss in the event of a database failure. Set to 15 minutes for the FirstUK production environment.

name: Recovery Time Objective
description: Service level agreement defining the maximum acceptable downtime for database recovery. Set to 2 hours for the FirstUK production environment.

name: Account Records Capacity
description: Current capacity metric for the accounts schema within the FirstUK production database.

name: Customer Records Capacity
description: Current capacity metric for the customers schema within the FirstUK production database.

name: Transaction Processing Rate
description: Monthly transaction volume processed through the FirstUK production database transaction log.

name: Debit Card Issuance Capacity
description: Current capacity metric for debit cards issued and tracked within the FirstUK production database.

name: Product Portfolio Size
description: Number of distinct banking products defined and available within the FirstUK product catalog.

name: Caching Layer
description: A Redis-based caching layer deployed to reduce database load and improve response times across the banking platform. Stores frequently accessed data including account balances, customer profiles, and fraud detection rules with varying time-to-live configurations.
context: Purpose: Reduce database load, improve response times

name: Account Balance
description: The current balance of a customer account, cached with a 5-minute time-to-live to optimize retrieval performance and reduce database queries.

name: Customer Profile
description: Customer information and profile data cached with a 10-minute time-to-live to support rapid customer lookups and reduce database load.

name: Fraud Detection Rule
description: A set of rules governing fraud detection logic, cached with a 1-hour time-to-live to enable consistent and performant fraud screening across transactions.

name: Internet Banking Platform
description: Customer-facing digital channel for account access and transactions, secured with username/password authentication and one-time password verification via email or SMS.

name: Mobile App
description: Mobile banking application providing customer access via biometric authentication (fingerprint or face recognition) with optional PIN as secondary factor.

name: LDAP/Active Directory
description: Internal identity and access management system used for staff authentication and authorization within the bank's infrastructure.

name: API Services
description: Internal API infrastructure secured with mutual TLS (mTLS) and JWT token-based authentication for service-to-service communication.

name: Audit Logging System
description: System that records and tracks all access events across the bank's infrastructure for compliance, security monitoring, and forensic investigation purposes.

name: Role-Based Access Control
description: Authorization framework that grants system access and permissions based on predefined user roles within the organization.

name: Attribute-Based Access Control
description: Fine-grained authorization mechanism applied to sensitive operations, allowing access decisions based on attributes of users, resources, and environmental conditions.
context: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) for sensitive operations

name: Multi-Factor Authentication Requirement
description: Mandatory security control requiring multiple authentication factors for administrative access to sensitive systems and functions.

name: Photo ID Verification for Branch Access
description: Authentication requirement for customers accessing the bank through physical branch locations, verified through photographic identification.

name: TLS 1.3 Protocol
description: Transport Layer Security protocol version 1.3 used for encrypting all external connections to FirstUK Bank systems. Provides cryptographic security for data in transit between external clients and bank infrastructure.

name: Mutual TLS Service Communication
description: Mutual Transport Layer Security protocol used for internal service-to-service communication within FirstUK Bank infrastructure. Ensures bidirectional authentication and encryption between internal microservices.

name: Database Backup Encryption
description: AES-256 encryption applied to all database backups to protect sensitive customer and operational data at rest. Ensures encrypted storage of backup copies across the bank's infrastructure.

name: S3 Bucket Storage
description: Amazon S3 object storage service configured with encryption to protect data at rest. Used by FirstUK Bank for secure storage of files and backups with encryption enabled.

name: Encrypted File System
description: File system-level encryption protecting data at rest across FirstUK Bank's storage infrastructure. Ensures all files stored on disk are encrypted to prevent unauthorized access.

name: Data Encryption in Transit Requirement
description: Mandatory requirement that all external connections to FirstUK Bank systems must use TLS 1.3 encryption, and internal service-to-service communication must use mutual TLS. Governs cryptographic protection of data while in transit.

name: Data Encryption at Rest Requirement
description: Mandatory requirement that all data stored at rest within FirstUK Bank systems must be encrypted using AES-256 for databases, S3 buckets, and file systems. Ensures protection of sensitive data in persistent storage.

name: AWS Secrets Manager
description: Cloud-based secrets management system used by FirstUK Bank to securely store and manage sensitive credentials, API keys, TLS certificates, and integration passwords. Implements automatic rotation of credentials on a 90-day cycle to maintain security compliance.

name: Database Credential
description: Authentication credentials used to access FirstUK Bank's database systems, managed and rotated through AWS Secrets Manager with automatic 90-day rotation cycles.

name: API Key
description: Authentication tokens used for API integrations with FirstUK Bank systems, securely stored and rotated automatically through AWS Secrets Manager.

name: TLS Certificate
description: Transport Layer Security certificates used to encrypt communications for FirstUK Bank systems and integrations, managed through AWS Secrets Manager.

name: Integration Password
description: Authentication passwords for third-party system integrations connected to FirstUK Bank, securely stored and automatically rotated every 90 days.

name: Credential Rotation Cycle
description: Automatic rotation schedule for database credentials and integration passwords managed through AWS Secrets Manager, enforcing a 90-day rotation interval for security compliance.

name: Public API Gateway
description: Public-facing API endpoint secured via HTTPS on Port 443 with ingress-only firewall rules. Serves as the primary interface for external API consumers.
context: Ingress: Port 443 (HTTPS) only for public APIs

name: Branch Systems VPN Access
description: Secure VPN-only access channel for branch office systems, restricting direct network connectivity and enforcing encrypted tunneling.

name: AWS Shield
description: Managed DDoS protection service provided by AWS to defend against distributed denial-of-service attacks on FirstUK Bank infrastructure.

name: CloudFlare
description: Optional third-party DDoS protection and content delivery service available for deployment if additional protection is needed.

name: AWS GuardDuty
description: AWS-managed threat detection service that identifies malicious activity and unauthorized behavior across FirstUK Bank infrastructure.

name: Log Analysis and Alerting System
description: Centralized logging and alerting infrastructure that monitors security events and generates notifications for suspicious or anomalous activity.

name: Admin Access IP Whitelist Control
description: Administrative access is restricted to a predefined set of approved IP addresses, enforcing network-level access control for privileged operations.

name: HTTPS-Only Ingress for Public APIs
description: All public API ingress traffic must use HTTPS on Port 443, prohibiting unencrypted HTTP connections and enforcing transport-layer security.
context: Ingress: Port 443 (HTTPS) only for public APIs

name: Branch System VPN-Only Access Requirement
description: All branch office systems must connect through VPN tunnels, prohibiting direct network access and ensuring encrypted communication channels.

name: Recovery Time Objective
description: The maximum acceptable downtime for system recovery following a disaster event. Set at 2 hours to ensure rapid restoration of banking services.

name: Recovery Point Objective
description: The maximum acceptable data loss measured in time, defining the point to which systems and data must be recovered. Set at 15 minutes to minimize transaction loss.

name: Backup Frequency
description: The operational schedule for data backup and replication to support disaster recovery objectives. Combines daily full backups with continuous replication for near-real-time protection.

name: Database Backup System
description: Core database backup infrastructure supporting FirstUK Bank operations through continuous replication to standby systems, daily encrypted backups to S3, and weekly backups to cold storage. Implements multi-tier retention strategy with real-time failover capability.
context: Daily encrypted backup to S3 (retention: 30 days)
Weekly backup to cold storage (retention: 1 year)

name: Amazon S3 Storage
description: Cloud storage service used for daily encrypted database backups with 30-day retention policy as part of FirstUK Bank's backup strategy.
context: Daily encrypted backup to S3 (retention: 30 days)

name: Cold Storage System
description: Long-term archival storage system for weekly database backups with 1-year retention policy, providing extended data preservation for FirstUK Bank.
context: Weekly backup to cold storage (retention: 1 year)

name: Git Repository
description: Version control system storing FirstUK Bank application source code with full revision history and collaborative development capabilities.

name: AWS Elastic Container Registry
description: Container image registry service hosting FirstUK Bank Docker images for application deployment and version management.

name: Configuration Version Control
description: Version control system maintaining FirstUK Bank application configuration files with full audit trail and change tracking.

name: Database Backup Retention Period - S3
description: Operational target specifying the retention duration for daily encrypted database backups stored in S3.
context: Daily encrypted backup to S3 (retention: 30 days)

name: Database Backup Retention Period - Cold Storage
description: Operational target specifying the retention duration for weekly database backups stored in cold storage.
context: Weekly backup to cold storage (retention: 1 year)

name: Database Replication Recovery Time Objective
description: Availability target for continuous real-time database replication to standby systems, enabling immediate failover capability.

name: Encrypted Backup Requirement
description: Operational constraint requiring all daily database backups to S3 to be encrypted, ensuring data protection and regulatory compliance.
context: Daily encrypted backup to S3 (retention: 30 days)

name: Continuous Database Replication Requirement
description: Operational constraint mandating continuous real-time replication of database to standby systems for disaster recovery and business continuity.

name: Disaster Recovery Testing Frequency
description: The required frequency for conducting disaster recovery tests across FirstUK Bank's critical systems and infrastructure. Testing must occur at least quarterly to ensure readiness and validate recovery procedures.

name: Database Restoration from Backup
description: A mandatory disaster recovery test scenario requiring the bank to validate its ability to restore database systems from backup media. This ensures data integrity and recovery time objectives are met during actual disaster events.

name: Application Failover to Standby Region
description: A critical disaster recovery test scenario validating the bank's ability to automatically or manually switch application processing from the primary region to a geographically separate standby region. This ensures business continuity during regional outages.

name: Network Failure Simulation
description: A disaster recovery test scenario that simulates network connectivity failures to validate system resilience and failover mechanisms. This ensures the bank can maintain critical operations during network outages.

name: Data Loss Scenario
description: A disaster recovery test scenario simulating catastrophic data loss to validate backup integrity, recovery procedures, and the bank's ability to restore critical data within acceptable recovery time objectives.

description: Mobile banking platform processing 300–500 daily transactions with peak capacity of 3 queries per second and p95 response time under 2 seconds.
